instructions: Place the base part on the work surface.
title: Start with the Base plinth

instructions: Box body: bottom to the top of the Base plinth (fixed).
title: Attach Box body to the Base plinth

instructions: Top plate: bottom to the top of the Box body (fixed); Drawer front: back to the front of the Box body (on its slide); Front badge plate: back to the front of the Box body (fixed).
title: Attach Top plate, Drawer front, Front badge plate to the Box body

instructions: Drawer knob stem: back to the front of the Drawer front (fixed).
title: Attach Drawer knob stem to the Drawer front

instructions: Dome flange ring: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw NE: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw NW: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw SE: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed); Top plate screw SW: bottom to the top of the Top plate (fixed).
title: Attach Dome flange ring, Top plate screw NE, Top plate screw NW and 2 more to the Top plate

instructions: Polished dome: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw N: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw S: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw E: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed); Flange screw W: bottom to the top of the Dome flange ring (fixed).
title: Attach Polished dome, Flange screw N, Flange screw S and 2 more to the Dome flange ring

instructions: Drawer pull cap: back to the front of the Drawer knob stem (fixed).
title: Attach Drawer pull cap to the Drawer knob stem

instructions: Shaft collar: bottom to the top of the Polished dome (fixed); Bean fill lid: bottom to the top of the Polished dome (hinged).
title: Attach Shaft collar, Bean fill lid to the Polished dome

instructions: Lid lift tab: bottom to the top of the Bean fill lid (fixed).
title: Attach Lid lift tab to the Bean fill lid

instructions: Spindle shaft: bottom to the top of the Shaft collar (fixed).
title: Attach Spindle shaft to the Shaft collar

instructions: Crank arm: bottom to the top of the Spindle shaft (on its shaft).
title: Attach Crank arm to the Spindle shaft

instructions: Cap nut: bottom to the top of the Crank arm (fixed); Knob stem: back to the right of the Crank arm (fixed).
title: Attach Cap nut, Knob stem to the Crank arm

instructions: Handle knob: top to the bottom of the Knob stem (fixed).
title: Attach Handle knob to the Knob stem
